صَفُوحٌ One who has the quality of turning away from the crimes, sins, faults, or offences, of others, and of forgiving; [or rather wont to turn away &c.;] as also ↓ صَفَّاحٌ : (TA:) الصَّفُوحُ, (K, TA,) as an epithet applied to God, (TA,) means the Very Forgiving; or He who forgives much. (K, TA.) ―
-b2- And Generous; (K;) because the generous man forgives those who act injuriously towards him. (TA.) ―
-b3- And A woman who turns away from one; who forsakes one's society: as though not giving aught but her side. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
